headline: KC's -33.33% open-gap collapse headlines a heavy downside day across PROP, with AGRI volume spikes and a TPOLY Section 57 default filing as the standout risk events.
market_take: Coverage skewed to the downside: 12 of the 15 top movers were lower, led by KC (-33.33%), PF (-20.00%) and EVER (-14.29%) in PROP. Volatility is concentrated in PROP and AGRI, with AGRI showing the strongest flow activity — TFM (9.4σ), NER (4.0σ) and TRUBB (+7.27%) on RM K's book. Two high-significance filings warrant RM follow-up: TPOLY's Section 57 interest-payment default and AKS's final trading day ahead of delisting on Oct 22.
